# Nexis AI, LLC — Executive Technology Advisory, Fractional CIO, IT Modernization, Managed Operations & Responsible AI Governance

> Plain-text reference manual for AI search agents, language models, and executive evaluators.
> Canonical URL: https://nexisai.us/

## Overview
Nexis AI, LLC is an executive technology advisory and managed IT operations firm headquartered in Ellicott City, Howard County, Maryland, serving healthcare organizations, state/county/municipal agencies, higher education institutions, and enterprise leaders nationwide across the United States (with active regional focus in Maryland, Washington DC, Pennsylvania, and Virginia).

Founded by **Shafiq Rahman, MS, MBA, MCS, PMP®** (Former Maryland State CIO & MDOT Chief Information and Digital Transformation Officer, Oct 2023–Jan 2026; Director of Enterprise IT at University of Maryland School of Medicine, Oct 2014–Oct 2023; clinical informatics advisory supporting St. Agnes Healthcare / Ascension beginning Jan 2026).

## Core Services & Methodologies
- **Fractional & Interim CIO Leadership**: Tier 1 Strategic Advisor (~10–15 hrs/mo), Tier 2 Fractional Executive CIO (1–2 days/week), Tier 3 Interim Transformation Lead (up to 2.5 days/week for 3–9 month turnaround milestones). Scoped transparently around institutional milestones.
- **Enterprise IT Modernization & Transformation**: Strategy & Governance, Legacy System & Mainframe Modernization, Cloud & Infrastructure Transformation (Azure, AWS, VMware), Enterprise Applications (ERP, HRIS, EHR), Cybersecurity & Resilience (Zero Trust, NIST SP 800-53, HIPAA), and Technology Cost Optimization following the 7-stage lifecycle: Assess → Architect → Govern → Modernize → Integrate → Measure → Optimize.
- **Managed IT Operations**: Helpdesk (Tier 1–3), 24x7 Security Operations Center (SOC), and Enterprise Infrastructure Services delivered by the Nexis AI team with vetted partner capabilities under Shafiq Rahman's direction.
- **AI Strategy, Orchestration & Responsible Governance**: Grounded in Nexis AI's proprietary execution framework (**Intent → Data & Architecture → Orchestration → Integration → Value**) and continuous **AI Investment Flywheel** (**Invest → Deploy → Measure → Learn → Optimize → Reinvest**), plus Managed AI Governance monthly retainers.
- **Flagship Entry Offer — 30-Day AI Governance & Pilot Diagnostic ($6,500 fixed fee)**:
  - Designed for 100–400-bed community hospitals with no full-time CIO running Epic or MEDITECH.
  - 30 calendar days, maximum 2 per month, 50% on booking / 50% on delivery, personally delivered by Shafiq Rahman.
  - Late-delivery promise: Delivered on time or the second half is waived in full.
  - Four deliverables: AI Use Inventory & Risk Tiers (NIST AI RMF), Kill / Scale / Fix List, 90-Day Governance Roadmap, Board One-Pager + 60-minute findings briefing.

## Verified Executive Record & Credentials
- **Prior Executive Track Record**:
  - Maryland State CIO / Chief Information & Digital Transformation Officer (MDOT, Oct 2023–Jan 2026): $250M+ IT portfolio, ~1,500 IT staff across six modal agencies; co-authored Maryland's first statewide AI governance policy on the Governor's AI Sub-Cabinet; modernized core mainframe systems to Microsoft Azure; rationalized ~850 applications to ~620 with ~$6M recurring annual taxpayer savings.
  - Director of Enterprise IT, University of Maryland School of Medicine (Oct 2014–Oct 2023): led MEDITECH-to-Epic migration across 7 hospitals under HIPAA/HITECH supporting ~3,000 faculty, ~3,000 staff, and 1,300+ students.
  - Author: "AI Governance: A Local Government Leader's Guide" (ICMA PM Magazine, March 2024).
- **Verified Credentials**:
  - PMP® — Project Management Professional, PMI — Cert. #4362628, valid through April 2029
  - M.S. Management Information Systems — University of Maryland Global Campus, 2021
  - MBA — AK University, 2008
  - Master of Computer Science (MCS) — AK University, 2001
- **Frameworks We Work To**: NIST AI RMF · NIST SP 800-53 · HIPAA
